description: This is a Python source file implementing a security guardrail for LiteLLM that integrates with Noma Security's AI-DR API. The guardrail intercepts and analyzes conversational messages and LLM responses for policy violations, supports quick blocking, anonymization, and background processing, and includes comprehensive methods for handling API interaction, verdict determination, and response modification.

classes.name: NomaBlockedMessage
classes.description: An exception class indicating that a message has been blocked by the Noma guardrail.

classes.description: A security guardrail for LiteLLM integrating with Noma Security's API to enforce content safety policies, perform real-time checks, handle anonymization, and support background processing.
